What is the best way to deal with submissions about veuwer being down or problems which /u/Icy-Defiance already fixed?

I tend to differentiate between downtime and issues of the code or the site.

  • Code issues or problems with the site itself should not be deleted. This way the evolution of veuwer is logged in this sub.

  • I'm not so sure regarding downtime or minor problems. Maybe downtime posts should be deleted even more since Icy-Defiance is so fast and transparent if the server is down or minor problems are experienced. It may be confusing for others to not delete them when veuwer is up again. Or a follow up post about the fix is the better option, like "Veuwer up again" or something alike?

What do you think?
How to deal with posts about downtime and issues with the site in this sub if the problem is fixed?
Well, I can add flair to posts. Don't think it'll show up in /v/all, but I'm not too worried, since people can just test the site themselves to see if it's online.

If it is a problem with the code or the site your approach to add a flair might be a good option.

But if it is a minor problem or just downtime then I think you should not take this on yourself since you already addressed the issue if it is fixed and posted a comment about it, like you did in the past. I think, you shouldn't waste time correcting submissions that are not up to date anymore.

The community may be in charge if this happens since the community posted a downtime note to which you responded and you have no control over the submission, though you fixed the issue.

That's why I tend to think deleting downtime posts if they are solved or making another post that everything is alright again, may be more appropriate.

So the question remains: Which option is the better one? Deleting the downtime/minor problem submission or posting a follow up that everything is good again?

Edit: In addition to your comment regarding a minor problem you could address a minor issue by submitting a fix post. This results in more workload for you but gives you control over the situation.
